items.title: 3 Ways to Play Unusual Options Activity in Kraft Heinz (KHC) Stock
items.summary: Kraft Heinz options volume surged after peer earnings spooked packaged-food stocks. Trades included a large put buy, a 5,040-contract bull call spread, and a 1,000-contract opening LEAPS call — institutions hedging near-term risk while positioning for a multi-year recovery.

items.title: 2 Mid-Cap Stocks to Keep an Eye On and 1 We Avoid

However, their paths to becoming $100 billion corporations are ripe with competition, ranging from giants with vast resources to agile upstarts eager to disrupt the status quo.
